column1: # One search per child in the Uruguayan indexes. Yield is uneven and is reported as such.
# *** Nothing here is attached to the line. Index entries are SECONDARY and these are candidates. ***
*** AVELINO - AND A BRANCH THIS ARCHIVE HAS NEVER NAMED: LERENA VILLADEMOROS ***
column2: *** 'Avelino Eduardo Lerena', spouse CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***, with children indexed under the compound *** LERENA VILLADEMOROS *** - Pedro Gualberto and Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre. And *** 'Avelino Lerena, born 1869, died 5 January 1914, Montevideo, parents Celedonia Villademoros' ***.
column4: *** THE ARCHIVE KNOWS AVELINO LERENA AS THE HUSBAND OF AMBROSIA TRAIBEL *** - the Lerena Traibel branch it has carried since its first week. *** It has never heard of Villademoros. *** Two readings, and this archive is not choosing between them: *** either Avelino Lerena Fernandez (b. 1815) married twice ***, Ambrosia before May 1843 and Celedonia later, *** or Avelino Eduardo is a SON of his *** and the Villademoros children are Sancho's great-grandchildren. *** A note already in this archive says of another woman that 'she does not fit the Avelino this archive knows, who was married to Ambrosia Traibel' - so the two-Avelino problem was already suspected. *** Recorded unattached, as that one was.

column1: *** FIDEL - thin, and what little there is points at a branch already held ***
column2: *** 'Fidel Lerena, Child - parents Cipriano Martinez, VICTOR LERENA - siblings MARIA RUEDA...' *** and an unplaced *** 'Fidel Lerena ... Children Feliz Llama' ***.
column4: *** THE FIRST IS THE MONTEVIDEO BRANCH THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY FOUND *** through Victor Lerena, where *** Fidel Lerena married Maria Ruedas *** - the index has garbled the relationships but the names are the same cluster. *** It does NOT establish that this Fidel is Sancho's son born about 1799 ***, which remains the open question. *** 'Feliz Llama' is tantalising and is not evidence *** - it could be a mangled Felix Llerena, and a mangled index entry is not a person.

column1: *** PEDRO ANTONIO - his marriage was known; his CHILDREN were not ***
column2: *** 'Pedro Antonio Llerena ... Spouses Vicenta Vega ... Children Manuel Antonio' and '... Children Vicenta Margarita' ***, with his mother given in one entry as *** Maria Fernandez ***. Plus *** 'Pedro Antonio Natalio, christened 12 December 1828 at the Cordon, born 1 December 1828' ***.
column4: *** THE ARCHIVE ALREADY HAD THE MARRIAGE *** - Vicenta Vega *** natural de Cerro Largo, daughter of Don Romualdo and Dona Andrea Maestre *** - but not the children. *** Manuel Antonio, Vicenta Margarita and a Pedro Antonio Natalio baptised at the Cordon in December 1828 *** are new. *** The index naming his mother as Maria Fernandez is consistent with him being Sancho's son ***, though the same index garbles his father in another entry as 'Francisco Llorena', which is why these are recorded as candidates and not attached.
